question: An Enterprise organisation wants its members to use the Google Drive connector, but with read access only. Which sequence of steps is correct?
options: A) Members authenticate individually; the owner enables the connector; the team confirms the limits; the owner restricts it to read actions.
B) The owner enables the connector; the owner restricts it to read actions; members authenticate individually; the team confirms the limits.
C) The owner restricts it to read actions; the team confirms the limits; members authenticate individually; the owner enables the connector.
D) The team confirms the limits; members authenticate individually; the owner restricts it to read actions; the owner enables the connector.
correct_answers: B) The owner enables the connector; the owner restricts it to read actions; members authenticate individually; the team confirms the limits.
explanations: Members cannot authenticate before the owner has enabled the connector.
Correct. Enablement and action restrictions are owner-level and come before individuals connect their own accounts.
Restrictions are configured for a connector that has not been enabled yet.
The limits are confirmed first and the connector is enabled last, which reverses the setup.
